translations.web: The king said to him, “How many times shall I adjure you that you speak to me nothing but the truth in Yahweh’s name?”
translations.bsb: But the king said to him, “How many times must I make you swear not to tell me anything but the truth in the name of the LORD?”
translations.kjv: And the king said to him, How many times shall I adjure thee that thou say nothing but the truth to me in the name of the LORD?
